content_data.project_title: Elevating European Travel: Content Strategy for AI-Powered Discovery Platform
content_data.project_description: A comprehensive content strategy proposal to enhance user engagement and brand authority for an AI-driven travel platform focused on the European market, leveraging storytelling and strategic content deployment.
content_data.timeline: Initial 3 months for strategy development and pilot content, with ongoing implementation over the subsequent 9 months.
objectives: Establish the brand as a thought leader in AI-powered European travel through high-quality, narrative-driven content.
Increase organic traffic by 30% to key European destination pages within the first year.
deliverables: SEO Keyword Strategy & Implementation Plan (multi-lingual, European-specific)
Pilot Content Package (e.g., 3-5 long-form articles, 10-15 short-form social posts, 2-3 interactive guides)
Editorial Calendar & Content Plan (6-month rolling, incorporating AI-powered insights)
Comprehensive Content Audit & Gap Analysis (European market focus)
